name: NationGate Holdings Berhad
overview: NationGate 于 2026 年 1 月完成以 RM60,888,000 收购 Valeo Malaysia CDA Sdn Bhd 全部股权，将这家公司纳入集团。其余公告主要为股息、股东大会及关联交易授权等公司事务，未见其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约公告。
overview_en: In January 2026, NationGate completed the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Valeo Malaysia CDA Sdn Bhd for RM60,888,000, bringing the company into the group. The remaining announcements mainly cover dividends, general meetings and shareholder mandates for recurrent related party transactions, with no other announcements on expansion, reduction or contracts for other business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面完成一项全资收购，将 Valeo Malaysia CDA Sdn Bhd 纳入旗下。
segments.note_en: At group level, a wholly-owned acquisition was completed, bringing Valeo Malaysia CDA Sdn Bhd into the group.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: NationGate 间接全资子公司 NationGate System Sdn Bhd 以 RM60,888,000 收购 Valeo Malaysia CDA Sdn Bhd 全部 168,200,000 股普通股。
actions.text_en: NationGate's indirect wholly-owned subsidiary NationGate System Sdn Bhd acquired the entire 168,200,000 ordinary shares of Valeo Malaysia CDA Sdn Bhd for RM60,888,000.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 集团通过收购 Valeo Malaysia CDA Sdn Bhd 全部股权，将该公司纳入为间接全资子公司。
model_changes.text_en: The group brought Valeo Malaysia CDA Sdn Bhd into the group as an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary through the acquisition of its entire equity interest.
